extracted.intended_audience: Beginners and early/intermediate improvisers interested in learning musical improv (no prior singing experience required); prospective students of Magnet Theater
extracted.subtask_description: An 8-week beginner musical improv class teaching the song structures, ensemble skills, and performance techniques needed to create improvised musical numbers; offers both weekly and intensive scheduling. Culminates in a class performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Put thoughts and emotions into song
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn how to put your thoughts and emotions into song and take your improv scenes to the next level!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course goal is to translate internal life (thoughts/emotions) into improvised sung material to enhance scenes; treated as a foundational expressive skill rather than requiring prior singing proficiency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Song structures for on-the-spot musicals
rubrics_metrics.description: In this 8-week course you will learn the song structures you need to make up musicals on the spot.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on learning practical song forms and frameworks that support spontaneous creation of musical numbers during scenes.

rubrics_metrics.name: No prior singing experience required
rubrics_metrics.description: No need to be an experienced singer!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages beginners and lowers the barrier to entry; the curriculum is designed to teach musical improv skills independent of formal vocal training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensemble skills: group dynamic, support, and movement
rubrics_metrics.description: Through exercises in group dynamic, support, and movement, you will learn how to turn every song you improvise into a full-blown musical number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training includes collaborative exercises focusing on ensemble awareness, supporting scene partners, and physicality/movement to build cohesive musical scenes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Turn songs into full-blown musical numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: You will learn how to turn every song you improvise into a full-blown musical number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on expanding short improvised songs into structured, theatrical musical moments suitable for performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Course format and culminating performance
rubrics_metrics.description: 8 weeks of classes followed by a class performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Structured weekly classes with a final in-class performance provide a progression from skill-building to presentation; also offered as intensive formats (multi-day) for condensed study.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scheduling and format options (weekly or intensive)
rubrics_metrics.description: Classes are offered as weekly evening sessions and as week-long daytime intensives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Students can choose between regular weekly classes (Thursdays 6pm–8pm) or intensive formats (Mon–Fri 11:30am–3:30pm) to fit different learning preferences and time constraints.
